name: PLUS
note: Multi-year founding partner of Korean Golf Club, described by LIV Golf (May 2026) as 'a division at Hanwha Life'; the exact brand entity within Hanwha is unclear (Hanwha Life operates the LIFEPLUS brand at lifeplus.co.kr). Hanwha Life's shareholder list includes state agency Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation (10%); per METHOD.md a South Korean public holder is not a link to abuse. Company check (2026-10-03, review): nothing found against Hanwha Life itself, BUT Hanwha Aerospace (Hanwha Group, whose holding company Hanwha Corporation owns 43.24% of Hanwha Life) has repeated worker deaths at its Daejeon plant: explosions in 2018 (5 dead) and 2019 (3 dead) - court rulings found severe safety negligence and the guilty verdict against the responsible person was upheld on appeal (Chosun Ilbo, 2026-06-03) - and a third explosion in June 2026 killed 5 more, after which the Ministry of Employment and Labor found 473 legal violations, sent 189 for criminal proceedings and booked CEO Son Jae-il under the Serious Accidents Punishment Act (Yonhap, 2026-10-01; Chosun, 2026-06-08). Hanwha Ocean also has repeated fatal shipyard accidents (2024-2025) under MOEL investigation. Whether METHOD.md's company test reaches Hanwha Corporation (and thereby this sponsor) or only its operating subsidiaries is a maintainer decision; until then this sponsor is unrated.
